mydllyk2.text: Mydllyk2 lets the headshots do the talking: well above average on the matchup board, quick-handed, and calm when the opposition stiffens. The accuracy is ordinary, but the shots that connect tend to land where they count. The lifetime board tells roughly the same story as the matchups, which keeps the story honest: a strong regular with a sharp eye.

minsickflava.text: MinsickFlava brings a complete, high-tempo game: matchup rating and activity both at the very top, with bravery to match and a pace that never relents. The accuracy sits near the top, and the lifetime board tells the same story as the matchups. A player who sets the tempo and keeps it there from first fight to last.

mrwe1.text: MrWE1 fights at the very top of the tracked population: matchup rating and resistance both among the very best, with a matchup K/D line to back it up. The pace is brisk rather than frantic, and the lifetime board paints a middling picture, with the lifetime IvI far below what the matchups support. A player whose matchups dwarf the lifetime numbers.

moroccanprodigy.text: MoroccanProdigy arrived recently and already belongs at the highest level: sits with the best tracked across nearly every measure, with a driving rhythm, and solid as the opposition hardens. The form stays strong against the strongest third, which is rare this early. A young account still, and the opening pages already carry weight.

minssick.text: Minssick never waits for the fight to come to them: among the very best tracked, blistering tempo behind it, producing at full volume as the opposition improves. The matchup kill-death line sits near the top, and the edge against the toughest opposition dips a little. A relentless game, with no quiet corners.

motormaker.text: Motormaker has been at this since 2018 and still fights at the summit: up with the very best tracked, unrelenting tempo driving it, pressure up as the opposition improves. Lifetime and matchup numbers agree with each other, and the strongest-third share dips a little. Years in, still running at full speed.

modopop.text: Since 2013, modopop has been a model of the quiet elite: sitting high among everyone tracked, steady against whatever the fight brings. The hardest opposition leaves them unbothered. The lifetime IvI undersells them, sitting mid-pack where the matchups see a top-tier player. A long, calm career, still sharp after all these years.

makabakacn.text: MaKaBaKaCN plays a sharp, high-volume game built on pace and shape: a brisk output, a game that keeps its shape against improving opposition, and a first-rate mark. The aim sits well above average. The lifetime IvI sits above average as well, so the lifetime board puts them a little below the matchups.

macintoshnc.text: MacintoshNC sets a blistering tempo: top shelf on the matchup board, with pace among the very best tracked and aim to match. Matchup kill-death sits barely above average, the lone soft spot on the card. Read this one as a sketch built on an older, smaller opponent sample.

millertesternc.text: MillerTesterNC has fought since 2016, and a decade of it shows in top-shelf matchup numbers, speedy, and firm as foes get stronger. The aim reads above average, the headshots find their mark, and the tempo stays high. Career board and matchups agree, end of story.

macintosheu.text: MacintoshEU plays at full sprint: top shelf almost across the board, with pace at the very top and bravery to match. The numbers keep climbing as the opposition gets stronger, which is rarer than it sounds. Accuracy sits near the top as well, and the lifetime ledger roughly tracks the matchups.

metalknightvs.text: MetalKnightVS has been at this since 2017, and plays a measured game: sitting top shelf, with the kill-death line near the very top. The pace sits above average and the aim sits mid-table, while the lifetime IvI number lags well behind. When the going gets hardest, the grip loosens a lot.

millertestertr.text: MillerTesterTR has been at this since 2016, and it shows: top shelf across the matchups, with tempo near the very top and courage to match. The lifetime ledger agrees with the matchups closely, and the aim stays steady across the board. A long career, still played at full tilt.

militerminatort76.text: miliTerminatorT76 grinds opponents down: the adjusted rating tops the card, the output pours in, the nerve holds, the staying power keeps pace. The matchup kill-death mark sits right beside it. The pace is fierce, accuracy lands near the top, and headshots account for a generous slice of the shots. The lifetime board backs it on every line, rating the whole career near the summit.

magierinsonea.text: MagierinSonea is the patient kind of danger: a matchup kill-death mark among the very best, and resistance that barely bends against the hardest opposition. The pace stays middling, the bravery sits mid-pack, and the accuracy and headshot share both land near the bottom. The lifetime board rates them low — yet the matchups say the fights they do take end decisively.

mahdrider.text: MahdRider fights strictly on their own terms: bravery near the very bottom, but a matchup kill-death mark among the very best tracked, with resistance to match. The pace is middling and the lifetime board sits near the bottom, so the matchups tell a far stronger story than the lifetime numbers do. When they choose a fight, they win it; the trick is they choose carefully.

microsofttechnicalsupport.text: MicrosoftTechnicalSupport brings a complete card: matchup rating, tempo, bravery, and resistance all sit near the very top, with a matchup mark to match. Accuracy is precise, headshots account for a strong share of attempts, and the consistency holds above average. Lifetime IvI sits among the best tracked, and the kill-death mark sits just above average on the lifetime side.

mushroommx.text: MushroommX plays a brisk, high-volume game: matchup rating, activity, and resistance near the top. This matchup kill-death line sits right there too. Pace sits near the top, and the aim is well above average with a solid headshot share. The edge drops against the strongest third, its one soft spot, while the lifetime board sits a notch below the matchups.

macinatortr.text: MacinatorTR plays a busy, climbing game: activity and bravery both near the top, a pace that keeps up with the fastest, and resistance holding its ground. The aim runs above the pack, with frequent headshots, and the lifetime sheet backs the matchup picture. The opponent sample behind this one is older and thinner, so read it as a sketch — but the sketch shows a first-rate fighter.

macintoshvs.text: MacintoshVS turns up the volume and never turns it down: the kill pace and the own pace both sit at the very top, with bravery to match. The aim is precise, headshots frequent, and the lifetime ledger echoes the matchups. The opponent sample here is older and narrower, so treat this as a sketch — though the sketch is loud.

medicschlumpf.text: MedicSchlumpf is a young account already running hot: activity and bravery both riding high, a pace near the very front, and a matchup kill-death mark right there too. The headshot share sits in the top ranks, and the lifetime numbers tell the same story. Early read, but the start already speaks volumes — the strongest third exposes the weak seam.

macintoshtr.text: MacintoshTR arrived loud: a young account already running at the fastest tempo tracked, with activity and kill pace both at the very summit. The game only sharpens against tougher opposition, and the aim lands with a headshot share near the top. Only consistency trails, dipping low enough that the strongest third bends the results. Early read, but the opening act is already electric.

moonzx.text: Moonzx has been at this since 2014, and the card shows the mileage in the best way: matchup rating, pace, and bravery all at the top. Resistance stays firm when the attacks get hardest, and the lifetime board rates them near the top. Consistency trails at mid-pack, the one line that never quite caught up. A veteran still playing every fight like the first one.

maskaranc.text: MaskaraNc sets a blistering pace: the tempo sits at the very top, while the game grows stronger as the enemies get tougher, and the matchup rating runs in the same range. Accuracy sits well above average, headshots sit mid-pack, and the lifetime board comes in at the same strong range. A relentless, high-volume presence that never lets up.

masterragebater.text: MasterRagebater plays like a detonation: a work rate near the very top, accuracy and headshots near the very top, while a game that only sharpens as enemies improve. The matchup mark sits near the top, with the lifetime board rating them even higher. Resistance sits above average, the lone line trailing a card otherwise set ablaze.

modelxindianxplayer.text: ModelxIndianxPlayer is a textbook in motion: accuracy in the topmost tier, a game that grows stronger as enemies improve, and a matchup grade near the top. mrdubi.text: MRDUBI is a wrecking ball with a ruler: accuracy near the very top, output near the top, and a game that climbs as the opposition improves. micrometerpeter.text: MicrometerPeter plays a measured, surgical game: resistance near the very top, a matchup kill-death mark to match, and a lifetime kill-death total among the best tracked. The accuracy sits below average, yet the headshot share runs high — fewer hits, but the ones that land count. The lifetime board rates them mid-pack, well below the matchups.

The lifetime board sits near the top too, confirming a game that runs hot on every line.

m00ncloud.text: M00ncloud plays a complete, high-tempo game: rating, activity, bravery, resistance all sit near the very top, with the output climbing as the enemies improve. The headshot share sits among the very best tracked, with the lifetime board rating them near the top too. A veteran since 2014, still sharp wherever the fight goes.

meltingcpu.text: MeltingCPU plays a precise, high-tempo game: accuracy among the very best tracked, with rating, activity, and bravery all near the very top. milkzzzzzz.text: Milkzzzzzz plays a fast, fearless game: rating, activity, bravery, and resistance all near the very top, with pace and output among the highest tracked. Accuracy sits near the top, and the lifetime board rates them well above average too. An account from 2024 already playing like a fixture.

maskaravs.text: MaskaraVs plays like someone who saves their best for the hardest rooms: the matchup rating sits near the top, with activity, bravery, and resistance keeping pace. The kill-death mark in real matchups is top-shelf too, and the lifetime board — solid, if a notch lower — still backs it up. Aim and headshots sit mid-pack, so the results come from positioning and nerve more than raw precision.

misingjiecaomi.text: MISingJiecaoMi plays like a storm front: output near the very top, a game that climbs as the opposition improves, and a rating to match. The aim is crisp, the headshots land often, and the lifetime numbers tell the same story. Only against the strongest third does the edge thin a little — the one soft seam in an otherwise relentless card.

monster899.text: monster899 wins the quiet way: middling pace, middling aim, and a matchup record near the very top anyway. The resistance is fierce — few opponents break through — and the game holds its shape as enemies improve. Headshots are scarce, the lifetime board sits mid-pack, yet the real fights keep going one way.

missjiecaonsm.text: MissJiecaoNSM plays a polished, complete game: rating, bravery, and resistance all sit top-tier, with a matchup kill-death mark to match. miyauchirenge.text: MiyauchiRenge plays with swagger and steel: rating, bravery, and resistance all run top-tier, with output that never lets up. Headshots land at a top rate and the aim stays sharp, so the kills come clean. The lifetime board sits right beside the matchups, and consistency is the only middling line.

msisstr.text: MSISSTR plays a grinding, effective game: resistance in the top tier, with rating and bravery close behind. The aim is ordinary, but headshots land often enough and the results hold up. The lifetime board sits one notch under the matchups, and the card reads solid throughout.

mabitememoule.text: Since 2016, MaBiteMeMoule has played the long, patient game: bravery and resistance just off the top, behind a matchup rating that stands in the upper tier, plus the duel kill-death count among the very best. The pace stays middling, the aim ordinary, and headshots come sparingly. Against the sharpest third the edge gives back a little — but the results have held up across a decade of battlefields.

micrometerpetertr.text: MicrometerPeterTR plays the long game of small advantages: bravery and resistance right there with a matchup rating that ranks in the upper tier, alongside the one-on-one kill-death tally well above average. The trigger runs at a solid clip, and the lifetime numbers echo the matchups. Headshots land with unusual regularity, the one flourish in an otherwise methodical game.

my5tcrimson.text: MY5TCrimson arrived days ago and already fights with remarkable patience: the matchup rating rests in the upper tier, resistance among the very best, and the one-on-one kill-death line at the very top. The pace runs ordinary and the aim middling, yet the results tower over both. Early read, but the opening chapter is a loud one.

m0ooooesy.text: m0ooooesy plays fast and finishes faster: among the top shelf of the matchup board, with bravery that holds as enemies get stronger and a faceoff kill-death count well above average. The tempo is top-shelf and the aim sits near the top, while the lifetime board tells the same story as the matchups. The wrinkle: facing the toughest opposition, the edge thins a little.

mugenroschi.text: Since 2012, Mugenroschi has been a fixture of the matchup board: top-tier in the ratings, fierce in tempo, and bravery that stands tall against sterner enemies. The skirmish kill-death score rides near the top, and the edge holds firm against the sternest third. Lifetime numbers sit mid-pack, more modest than the duels suggest. A veteran whose game has barely aged.

mrmime479.text: MrMime479 works in silence and lets the record speak: a top-shelf rating resting on resistance that bends rarely, and a duel count that holds up when the fighting gets harder. The lifetime numbers look far plainer, which only makes the matchups more striking. A quiet, disciplined fighter who wins without noise.

materialburst.text: MaterialBurst fires with rare precision: upper tier across the matchup board, accuracy near the very top, and a tempo to match. The headshot share lands mid-pack, the one quiet line on a loud card. The lifetime numbers echo the matchups, and the edge keeps holding against the strongest third — a complete fighter, through and through.

mswrabuse.text: MSWRabuse plays at a sprint and wins at a sprint: activity near the top, bravery near the top, and a pace that never lets up. The faceoff kill-death line sits above average, headshots land above average, and the lifetime board sits just behind the matchups. The edge dips when the opposition peaks, the one wrinkle in a fast, loud card.

moustlkette.text: MOUSTlKETTE arrived in 2024 and already fights like a fixture: in the top flight of the matchup board, quick hands, and unbothered as the battle heats up. The aim is the calling card here, precise and confident, with the headshots right behind it. A complete card from a player still writing their story.

maystreameu.text: MaystreamEU is the picture of a complete fighter: matchup rating near the summit, bravery that rises with the opposition, and resistance that takes the best shots going. The lifetime kill-death ratio sits top-bracket too, and the tempo keeps pace with all of it. Consistency lands mid-pack — the one quiet note in a loud, well-rounded record.
